title: VEERAN HAVELI MAIN
body:
VEERAN HAVELI MAIN
VEERAN HAVELI MAIN SUGHRA GHABRATI HAI
AB LAUT KE AA AKBAR, BEEMAR BULATI HAI
PARDES GAYE AAISE SUGHRA KI NA YAAD AAYI
<<DIVIDER>>
NANA KAI ROZE PE, FARYAD SUNAATI HAI
QADMON KE NISHAANO KO KABHI DEKH KAI ROTI HAI
ASGHAR KA KABHI JHOOLA  BEEMAR JHULAATI HAI
AB IN DEEVARON MAIN DAMM GHUTTA HAI SUGHRA KA
<<DIVIDER>>
LE KE NAAM AKBAR KA, WO ASHK BAHAATI HAI
AKBAR KI SHAADI KA LAYENGE PAYAAM CHACHA
IS BAAT PE DO SEHRA, BHAI KE BANAATI HAI
ULJAA HUA BARCHI ME AKBAR KA JIGAR DEKH
<<DIVIDER>>
IS KHAAB KI SUGHRA KO, TABEER RULAATI HAI
